mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mac_plog (user_id, plog_type, plog_points, plog_time, plog_remarks) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{points}, #{now}, #{remarks})
INSERT INTO mac_cash (user_id, cash_points, cash_money, cash_bank_name, cash_bank_no, cash_payee_name, cash_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{points}, #{money}, #{bankName}, #{bankNo}, #{payeeName}, #{now})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM mac_cash WHERE cash_id = #{cashId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND cash_status = #{status}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mac_cash (cash_id, user_id, cash_status, cash_points, cash_money, cash_bank_name, cash_bank_no, cash_payee_name, cash_time, cash_time_audit) VALUES (#{row.cashId}, #{row.userId}, #{row.status}, #{row.points}, #{row.money}, #{row.bankName}, #{row.bankNo}, #{row.payeeName}, #{row.time}, #{row.timeAudit})

INSERT INTO mac_order (user_id, order_code, order_price, order_time, order_points) SELECT #{userId}, #{code}, #{price}, #{now}, #{points} FROM DUAL WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mac_order AS o WHERE o.order_code = #{code})
